findings.summary: the record-rebuild case compares two censuses of nodes that differ only through the code under test, so it would pass vacuously if the census stopped charging the brief at all
findings.text: assert _census(rebuilt, ...) == _census(original, ...) is a sound guard against the rebuild dropping a field, and the run's negative control shows it reddening at EXIT=1 when the two fields are removed. But both sides are produced by context_census from nodes whose only difference is the rebuild, so a separate regression that stopped the brief being charged at all (both reading the same baseline) would leave the assertion true while the anchor saved nothing. An assert that the rebuilt node's figure is strictly below an unanchored control built in the same tmp_path would pin the charge as well as the equality.
